Canadian Natural Resources Limited [Canadian Natural Upgrading Limited Peace River Project] (2025). Peace River In Situ Oil Sands Project, Directive 054 Annual Performance Presentation, Commercial Scheme Approval 8143 (as amended). Reporting period 1 January to 31 December 2024; submitted to the Alberta Energy Regulator 9 December 2025. File 2025-cnrl-peaceriver-8143.pdf.

Reporting year 2024 (submitted Dec 9, 2025). Loaded: bitumen 375 m3/cd x 366 as annual-output and 2,000 m3/sd design as capacity (p.21). Other-values: plant steam output 3,200 m3/d CWE (incl. utility steam) and design 8,000, derived ratio 8.53, cumulative recovery. Not printed: fuel gas, electricity, cogeneration, GHG, water volumes, treatment type (an electrocoagulation trial for produced water is being evaluated, p.27), solvent (no co-injection in 2024), steam generators. Production plot p.6 is an unlabelled chart (skipped). Locator: PDF page = printed slide number. Traps: (1) actual bitumen is per calendar day, design per stream day; (2) steam includes utility steam, so 8.53 overstates SOR and no steam flow was written; (3) mixed SAGD/CSS/steamflood, low mapping confidence.
